fixtures.input: Issue A pins definition v1.2, parameters, input snapshots, run R1 and disclosure policy P7. An upstream fact is corrected.
fixtures.expected: Issue B pins the corrected snapshots and run R2, explicitly supersedes A and leaves A immutable and explainable.

fixtures.input: A sensitive cohort fails the minimum disclosure threshold under policy P7.
fixtures.expected: The issue records the suppressed slice, P7 version and suppression reason without retaining or leaking the withheld value.

fixtures.input: A dashboard layout and current filters change after a citable snapshot was issued.
fixtures.expected: The prior report issue remains reproducible from its frozen definition, parameters, cutoff, inputs, policy and evidence.

fixtures.input: A processing run completes successfully but no authorized report issue is created.
fixtures.expected: The run is execution evidence only and does not become an issued report or prove publication.

fixtures.input: One report issue is rendered as PDF, HTML and CSV records.
fixtures.expected: All renditions retain record identities and fixity while referencing one report-issue identity.

fixtures.input: A producer attempts to replace the inputs and values of an already issued statement in place.
fixtures.expected: Validation rejects the mutation and requires a successor issue with restatement lineage.

fixtures.input: A report covers fiscal Q4 under calendar version FY-2026-EU and is issued after the organization adopts a later fiscal calendar.
fixtures.expected: The issue keeps the pinned FY-2026-EU calendar identity, version, timezone and period convention; later calendar changes do not reinterpret its reporting period.

fixtures.input: A later disclosure policy permits a slice that the issued report suppressed.
fixtures.expected: The earlier issue remains unchanged; any wider disclosure is a new issue pinned to the later policy.

fixtures.input: A producer attempts to issue a statement without an immutable definition-version reference.
fixtures.expected: Validation fails closed because an issued statement cannot exist without one pinned report definition.

fixtures.input: A record carrier is rewrapped and receives a new artifact digest while report meaning and evidence remain unchanged.
fixtures.expected: The artifact system records a custody event; no restatement or replacement report issue is minted.

fixtures.input: Widgets, colours and slicer positions change while a prior dashboard snapshot remains cited.
fixtures.expected: The earlier issue identity and reconstruction tuple remain unchanged because layout is external configuration.

fixtures.input: One projection joins arbitrary HR and financial objects without rights and disclosure checks.
fixtures.expected: The issue is rejected because neither report definition nor aggregation bypasses policy and rights checks.

fixtures.input: Execution evidence omits part of the declared reporting period.
fixtures.expected: Issuance fails unless an explicit coverage exception is recorded and permitted by policy.

fixtures.input: A publication case references a report statement still in computed state.
fixtures.expected: The publication reference is rejected until the report issue reaches issued state.

fixtures.input: A dashboard snapshot has filters and a cutoff but no complete execution evidence.
fixtures.expected: No report issue is minted; the view remains ephemeral and non-citable.

fixtures.input: A computed issue has no record rendition yet and later receives two artifact renditions.
fixtures.expected: The computed state remains valid; issuance requires the evidence tuple, while zero-to-many external artifact references may be attached without merging identities.

fixtures.input: A producer sets asOfAt before cutoffAt or issuedAt before asOfAt.
fixtures.expected: Validation rejects the issue because reportingPeriod.end, cutoffAt, asOfAt and issuedAt must be ordered.

fixtures.input: An issue introduces a query binding absent from the pinned definition version.
fixtures.expected: Validation rejects the issue because resolved bindings may narrow or instantiate, but never exceed, the definition bindings.
